config.policy_delay: response wait after authority snapshot; added once per actual HTTP call; not a WAN simulator
config.prefilter: tenant-scoped current revoked-ID exclusion signed into per-request key before ANN; no post-search recheck
config.refill: successively requery entire prefix 5/10/20/40/80; recheck full prefix each round; stop after five admitted or exhaustion
config.race: no revocations during these serial requests; in-flight race excluded and stated in abstract

random_rule: random.Random(seed+9000).sample(range(1430), n); rate-specific sets; 143 uses previous sampling rule
scope: only stale metadata; never updates active flags during these serial requests
